title: MEDBENCH V4: A ROBUST AND SCALABLE BENCHMARK FOR EVALUATING CHINESE MEDICAL LANGUAGE MODELS, MULTIMODAL MODELS, AND INTELLIGENT AGENTS

measurement_description: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. The benchmark, MedBench v4, is designed to evaluate Chinese medical language models, multimodal models, and intelligent agents on clinical workflows, safety, and ethics within a medical context.
